How is the OIH valuation calculated? — The study uses an instrument-appropriate lens — a holding-company net-asset-value build that marks each asset on its own basis and values the Giza plateau concession by DCF, cross-checked with a consolidated FCFF discounted cash flow, peer P/NAV multiples and normalized earnings power — combined with a 50,000-path Monte Carlo simulation that expresses the result as a probability distribution. Every assumption is visible and editable in the free Excel model.
